notes.title: Migrating to Early Access!
notes.content: Tire Friend is out of Playtest and into Early Access. I think. Let's hope this works!

notes.title: New hub in the works!
notes.content:
The hub world is a work in progress, but it does tie in with the story.

Yes. [i]The story[/i].

notes.title: Save files!
notes.content: Multiple save files should work now. On the title screen, go to [b]Options > Data[/b]. Let your little brother or cousin or grandma have a turn!

notes.title: Powerup Reserves!
notes.content:
Got an Arc-Rated Tire Cover that you'd like to stash for a rainy (or fiery) day? No problem! On the World Map, there's now an easy-to-use (hopefully) mechanism to store your Powerups. Just touch the corresponding Powerup to grab one or store one (if one is equipped) before you enter a level.

There will also be a menu interface for it eventually, but where's the fun in that?

notes.title: Hints and refactors
notes.content:
Tire Friend has a bunch of new under-the-hood improvements. There are also helpful info text items that appear near powerups and other landmarks in earlier levels. 

Enjoy! Tell me if anything broke!

notes.title: Button glyphs! And a new Unity!
notes.content:
Button glyphs [i]should[/i] work for a couple different controllers. So if you have a DualShock, you'll know when to press Circle or Cross or what have you. In theory, anyway. If it's all broken, let me know!

Also upgraded to a new version of Unity. I think most of the glitches have been ironed out, but... also let me know if you see any.

notes.title: Still making levels...
notes.content: ...and there's more to come! Try it out and share your thoughts!
